description: Registre routier is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Provinz Flämisch-Brabant. The slow roads register contains the inventoried slow roads in Flanders. This means: roads that mainly serve slow traffic (pedestrians, cyclists and/or horse riders, possibly combined with agricultural or service vehicles) and that are used publicly. Coverage: Provinz Flämisch-Brabant. The portal shows the English title as "Road register" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Provinz Flämisch-Brabant. Its keywords include trage weg, buurtweg, voetweg, sentier, ABW. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
